advices.diagnosis: The class has a low method count (NOM=4) and modest complexity (WMC=4), but its cohesion metric LCOM4=2 signals two independent groups of behavior: presentation logic (title, describe_customer) and coordination with infrastructure (order_count, mail_summary). It also couples to two internal services (DCC=2). This split responsibility makes the class harder to maintain and test, and the warning on LCOM4 highlights a cohesion problem.

suggestions.title: Extract infrastructure coordination into a dedicated service

advices.risk_notes: Introducing a new class adds an extra layer of indirection; callers must be updated to provide a ReportCoordinator. If the application relies on ReportView's current constructor signature, those injection points need refactoring. The change is worthwhile only if the cohesion issue is causing maintenance pain; otherwise the added complexity may not be justified.
